profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Tel Aviv, listed under the ticker WIX, with CIK 0001576789. Its website describes Wix as a free, easy-to-use website builder that offers 2,000+ templates, built-in AI tools and a custom domain. The company says users can sell products, services and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins.

On the AI side, the site points to built-in AI tools as part of the builder and to specialized AI agents that the company says help keep a business growing. The material available does not name individual AI products or describe their underlying models, and it does not give pricing, usage or performance figures beyond the template count.

No litigation, regulatory filings beyond the company's registration details, or other products are recorded in the facts available here.
